title: Alert
description: An alert generated by a managed device

AlertDeviceName.description: Name of the device that generated the alert

SeverityType.description: Alert severity code. 1 is informational, 2 is normal, 4 is warning, 8 is critical, 16 is unknown.

StatusType.description: Alert acknowledgment status. 1000 is new, 2000 is acknowledged.

TimeStamp.description: Timestamp when the alert was generated

RecommendedAction.description: Recommended action to resolve the alert
